answers.core: A lot of games use light UI themes and especially people interested in building "Apps" in Godot. You figure about 50% of games/apps are light themed? therefore this affects about half of all projects and its very cumbersome to deal with.
answers.workaround: I haven't found a good true workaround as you can't make a canvas shader easily that doesn't also affect text and icons if you wanted to just modulate only the controls themselves.

title: Add a light theme preset for the default project theme and allow customizing the accent color
